description: Visit-coalescing probe (the reported 'Morgan was seen 62 times' bug, reproduced deterministically): a 60s continuous-face ken-burns clip (~30 raw per-segment sightings) injected twice, 4h apart, person enrolled as Judith. 'How many times did Judith come by?' must answer 2 VISITS, never the raw sighting count. Also gates the distinct-people count and the person profile. Media via fetch_eval_clips.sh.
